Vessel tracks: the track, a time panel of speed, trips, and the effort by cell

Source: R/tracks.R
og_tracks.Rd

og_tracks() draws vessel tracks, a row a ping, for a look at what a track's processing made of them: a time panel under the map with a vessel's speed over time and lanes of what it was doing and of its trips (a vessel chosen there, then one of its trips), the map showing that span's path and the pings coloured by what the vessel was doing; and the fishing effort by cell, summed from the fishing pings' hours, showing the chosen vessel's, its gear's or the fleet's (og_cells()'s follow).

Usage

og_tracks(
  map = NULL,
  pings = NULL,
  vessel = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  lon = NULL,
  lat = NULL,
  speed = NULL,
  activity = NULL,
  trip = NULL,
  gear = NULL,
  hours = NULL,
  lanes = NULL,
  marks = NULL,
  compare = NULL,
  fishing = NULL,
  effort = TRUE,
  cell = 0.01,
  time_label = "UTC",
  title = "Tracks",
  ...
)

Arguments

map

A map the pipe makes (og_map()), or the pings, which start one.

pings

The pings: a data frame, a lazy DuckDB table, or a parquet file's path; given here with no map, they start one, as in the map's place.

vessel, time, lon, lat, speed, activity, trip, gear, hours

The columns, as strings, where their names are not found: the vessel, the time, the position, the speed (more than one: the first shown, the others ticked on in the panel), what the vessel was doing (a lane, and the pings' colour), its trip (chosen in the panel, a trip at a time), its gear, and the hours each ping stands for (the effort's).

lanes

More lanes under the panel's chart, columns as strings (c(observed = "ACTIVITY_L1")): another method's trips, an observer's activity, ...

marks

Columns that mark pings, as og_time()'s marks.

compare

Two columns to hold against each other, as strings, named for their sources (c(ramb = "trip_id", EM4SSF = "TRIP_ID")), or a list of such pairs: two methods' trips, an inferred activity against an observer's. Each is a lane, and the panel marks, each a row of its own, the pings that one has and the other has not (in a trip by one method alone), and, where the two share their values ("fishing" in both), the pings they give differently.

fishing

The values of activity that are fishing, for the effort: by default those beginning "fish" (any case), or TRUE in a logical column.

effort

The effort by cell: TRUE, summed from the fishing pings' hours by vessel, gear and year at cell degrees; FALSE, none; or a table of cells for og_cells().

cell

The cells' side in degrees, when the effort is summed here.

time_label

The clock the times are on, shown beside them in the panel ("UTC" by default; "as written" for a file whose zone is not known).

title

The page's title.

...

More for og_cells(): palette, sizes, follow, ...

Value

The map.

Details

The columns are found by their names: ramb's (vid, time, lon, lat, speed, voyage_key or trip_id, gear, hours, and behaviour or activity) or EM4SSF's D2.1 format's (VESSEL_ID, DATE_TIME, LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, SPEED, TRIP_ID, ACTIVITY, GEAR), or given.

See also

og_time(), og_cells(); ramb, which makes trips, fishing and hours of a track.

Examples

# \donttest{
# the Danish small-scale vessels' tracks, as they come: behaviour, gear, no trips or hours
og_example("dansk") |>
  dplyr::filter(vessel_id %in% c("EX_1", "EX_12")) |>
  og_tracks(effort = FALSE)
#> <og_map> Tracks
#>   layers: pings (geojson)
#>   time panel: speed over time, 2 groups; lanes: behaviour
# }
